# @vllnt/convex-helpers

> TypeScript helpers for Convex backends: custom function builders, runtime
> validators, auth identity rows, Better Auth origins and an MCP tool server.

`@vllnt/convex-helpers` is a helpers library for Convex backends, not a Convex
component: it runs with the host's `ctx`, owns no tables and needs no
`app.use()`. It requires `convex@^1.45.0` and is ESM-only. Entries: the root
(`asyncMap`, `pruneNull`, `nullThrows`), `./builders` (`customQuery`,
`customMutation`, `customAction`, `customCtx`, matching
`convex-helpers/server/customFunctions` 0.1.136), `./validators` (`validate`,
`parse`, `doc`, matching `convex-helpers/validators` 0.1.136 except that the
`db` option is refused), `./identity` (`requireIdentity`, `getFromAuth`,
`requireFromAuth`, `getOrCreateFromAuth`, `retargetRows`), `./better-auth`
(trusted origins and HTTPS cookie options for `@convex-dev/better-auth`) and
`./mcp` (Convex functions as Model Context Protocol tools over Streamable HTTP;
needs the optional peers `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@^1.29.0` and `zod@^4.3.6`).

## For coding agents

Docs for the installed version ship in the package: `README.md`, `docs/API.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md` and this `llms.txt`. Types are in `dist/`, source in `src/`.

## When to use

- Use it for Convex function builders with shared `ctx` fields (`./builders`)
  and runtime checks against `v.*` validators (`./validators`).
- Use it to map the signed-in identity to a host user row (`./identity`).
- Use it for `@convex-dev/better-auth` origins and cookies (`./better-auth`), or
  to serve Convex functions as MCP tools over Streamable HTTP (`./mcp`).
- Do not use it for state such as rate limits, idempotency or API keys: use a
  `@convex-dev/*` or `@vllnt/convex-*` component.
- Do not use it for relationships, RLS or triggers: use `convex-helpers`.

## Limits

- `./identity` needs a host-configured, non-empty `AuthCtx.trustedIssuer`; it
  fails closed with `UNAUTHENTICATED` when missing, empty or mismatched.
  `getOrCreateFromAuth` creates one row only when lookup and insert run in the
  same mutation. `retargetRows` takes at most 1000 rows in sequence and is not
  an account merge.
- `./better-auth` checks origin syntax, not deployment ownership; SameSite=None
  cookies are not CSRF protection. The host constructs `betterAuth(...)`.
- `./builders` adds no authorization.
- `./mcp`: resources run no lifecycle hooks; no body, stream or deadline caps;
  auth and hook callbacks have a 10-second deadline; raw errors are not logged.
- On GitHub this file describes `main`; the copy in each npm version describes
  that version. `./better-auth`, `./identity`, `./builders` and `./validators`
  first ship in 0.2.0. The `canary` dist-tag moves: pin the exact version.
